question: How does this salutation connect Śiva’s increase of glory with the world?
premises: Śiva is addressed as increaser of glory.
Obeisance is also directed to the world.
Both are included in the salutation.
inference: The salutation honors Śiva as increaser of glory and extends obeisance to the world.
uncertainties: The relation between Śiva and the world in the fused token is compact.
plain_english: Obeisance to the increaser of glory, obeisance to the world.
